name: Mawroot

baseline.name: Mawroot
baseline.look: Root colony with amber cup flowers and fibrous folding leaves.
baseline.ecology: Captures small animals with warm sheltered hollows during cold rain.
baseline.limit: Warmth lure has a short range; cut fibers cannot rapidly regrow.
baseline.encounter: Guides recognize sweet resin without leaf mold; stepping back breaks the trap before it closes.
baseline.scale_note: Adult representative staging envelope; individuals vary by up to 10%. Not shown at common scale on the art plate.

daily: The rooted colony feeds slowly. Sun and decomposing leaf litter sustain much of its growth; small captured animals provide scarce nutrients. Warm cavities become most tempting during cold wet weather.
cycle: Flowers open in pulses after sustained rain. Seeds establish in undisturbed litter. A severed feeding leaf stays damaged through the scene and cannot regrow during a chase.
signs: Amber cups face the sheltered opening. Sweet resin without the usual leaf-mold smell is the guide warning. The warmth is local, not a valley-wide spell or emotional enchantment.
escalation: Open hollow -> leaf edges draw inward -> fibers brace -> slow closure. The rooted plant cannot chase someone who steps back; a trapped limb still requires help.
community: Canopy guides mark living colonies and teach children to identify them. Ripping out every colony damages banks and feeds a false belief that a cleared path stays safe forever.
scene: During rain, Neri notices that a supposedly helpful shelter has no old footprints or leaf litter. She lets a pupil name the inconsistency instead of turning it into her own lesson.
motion: Keep the root mass registered to the background. Use three designed leaf poses and slow overlap; flowers do not become eyes or a talking mouth.
sounds: Wet fiber tension and leaf rub. No voice, telepathy or deliberate impersonation of a person.
rule: Plant anatomy only: fibrous folding leaves and amber cup flowers. A hollow may look mouthlike, but has no jaw or teeth.
canon_status: Additive ecology and production guidance; proposed scene remains unadopted.
